query: We're starting a new multi-tenant SaaS with a web UI and a REST API, launching in English and Arabic next year, with roles each customer can edit. Which guardrails should we decide now?
expected_behavior: Chooses Plan mode and answers in chat without writing a file
Skips evidence gathering because there is no code or history, and says so
Ranks by fit weight / cost alone
Raises G23 (Arabic is right-to-left), G24 and G5 because the roadmap reaches their triggers
Does not raise G25, since no customer needs different behavior yet
Recommends the lightest version of each guardrail and names the traps to avoid
Omits verdicts (the Scoreboard and the Verdict column), the Evidence header line, and Evidence, Gap and Live bugs parts
Ranks the Required rows (G5 and G22, since customers edit roles) above every other row
Adds a new guardrail for a roadmap risk the catalog lacks (e.g. tenant data isolation), citing the roadmap line
